hook: JWST finds 39 new brown dwarfs in IC 348
what_happened: Luhman and Alves de Oliveira used JWST NIRCam and NIRSpec to identify 39 candidates, 15 spectra, nine confirmed substellar members
why_it_matters: Shows the lowest mass brown dwarfs (~2 M_Jup) exist, tightening the IMF minimum and revealing planet‑forming disks
the_catch: Only 15 spectra obtained; results limited to IC 348 field and current sensitivity
caption: Newly discovered brown dwarfs push the limits of star‑formation science.
alt_text: Carousel showing JWST images of IC 348 with highlighted brown dwarf candidates and spectra.
attribution: Luhman and Alves de Oliveira, The Astrophysical Journal Letters (2025)

es.hook: JWST descubre 39 nuevos enanos marrones en IC 348
es.what_happened: Luhman y Alves de Oliveira emplearon JWST NIRCam y NIRSpec para identificar 39 candidatos, 15 espectros y nueve miembros subestelares confirmados
es.why_it_matters: Demuestra que existen enanos marrones de menor masa (~2 M_Jup), reduciendo el mínimo del IMF y revelando discos que forman planetas
es.the_catch: Solo se obtuvieron 15 espectros; los resultados se limitan al campo de IC 348 y a la sensibilidad actual
